entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Li Shigu, also rendered as Yi Sago, was a Chinese military general and politician of the Tang dynasty, who, as the military governor (Jiedushi) of Pinglu Circuit, ruled the circuit in a de facto independent manner from the Tang imperial court.
